name: Motion language presets (brand physics)
description: Seven presets that set scene easing, duration, stagger and distance plus matching CSS motion tokens, so scenes, hovers and menus share one brand physics.
reduced_motion: Presets unchanged; the engines skip movement under reduced motion

name: Declarative scene builder (SVG parts by step)
description: Turns an SVG authored in its finished state into a stepped timeline: parts marked data-step and data-enter (drop, grow, pop, light, wipe, draw, count, move) arrive per step and can exit later.
reduced_motion: Scene is shown in its finished state or jumps step by step

name: Sticky scrollytelling (scene beside scrolling steps)
tags: scrollytelling|sticky|scroll story|storytelling|steps|sticky split|stage|build as you scroll|construction|process|how it works|story
description: Sticky stage beside (or behind) text steps; the scene timeline is scrubbed by scroll or played per active step, with the active step marked for styling and assistive tech.
easing: none when scrubbed; language ease in play mode
reduced_motion: No scrub: the scene jumps to each step's end state as the step becomes active

name: Sticky split layout for story scenes
tags: sticky split|scrollytelling layout|stage right|stage left|stage behind|stage top|mobile stage|story
description: Layout for story-scroll: sticky stage and step column with stage-right, stage-left, stage-top and stage-behind variants; phones pin a shorter stage on top with steps as cards.
reduced_motion: Step dimming transitions removed; all steps fully visible without JS

name: Pinned chapters with progress rail
description: Full-viewport chapters pinned in one place and changed by fade, wipe, slide or zoom as you scroll, with a rail showing which chapter you're on.
reduced_motion: Chapters stay as normal stacked sections

name: Before and after wipe (scroll + range)
description: Scroll-scrubbed clip-path wipe from the before to the after image, plus a labelled range input so anyone can compare by hand.
reduced_motion: Range input only; no scroll wipe

name: Manifesto text highlight on scroll
description: A belief or origin paragraph starts dim and brightens word by word as it is read, matching reading speed to scroll speed.

name: Zoom-through into the next scene
description: Pinned window or mask scales until it fills the viewport and reveals the next scene: entering a world, diving into a detail, or a closing reveal.
reduced_motion: Static: both scenes shown in order

name: Canvas image-sequence scrub (product rotation)
description: Draws pre-rendered frames on a canvas in step with scroll for a photoreal rotation or unboxing, with progressive preloading and fewer frames on phones.

name: Route or timeline path journey
description: An SVG route draws with scroll while a marker follows it and stops light up as they're passed: supply chains, travel, histories, processes.
reduced_motion: Path fully drawn; marker at the end; all stops active

name: Lottie, Rive, video and 3D stage adapters
description: Turns a dotLottie player, a Rive number input, a video or any render loop into an onProgress target, so non-SVG stages plug into story-scroll.
reduced_motion: Stage shows its poster or first frame

name: StoryScroll for React / Next.js (GSAP)
description: Client component and hook that render the story-scroll markup around server-rendered stage and step content and clean up every ScrollTrigger on unmount.

name: Sticky steps with Motion (React)
description: The sticky-scene pattern built with Motion's useScroll and useTransform, for projects already using Motion instead of GSAP.
reduced_motion: useReducedMotion: stage shows discrete step states
